title: Agentic Jailbreak Escalation Benchmark: Measuring Safety Degradation When LLMs Use Tools

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tool-enabled agents are the frontier of deployment. If tool access creates a safety blindspot where models refuse in chat but comply with tools, this is a critical unmeasured vulnerability. Compelling chain with direct implications for agentic deployment safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Setting up sandboxed tool environments (mock web search, code execution) is significant engineering work. Testing tool-enabled vs chat-only conditions requires an agent framework. This goes well beyond basic Python and API calls for beginner CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions (chat vs tool-enabled) across 30-50 prompts sounds focused, but building the sandboxed tool environment is a project in itself. The 'Agentic Safety Delta' is clear but the infrastructure to measure it is substantial. Likely exceeds 30 hours.
